description:
Long-term climate exposure at a place: every climate layer on the Criora map, read there.

Includes the latest full year of ERA5 reanalysis, a single year named in each layer's year
field rather than a multi-year normal (hottest day, coldest night, hot and frost day counts,
wind, extreme rain days, UTCI), warming and rainfall change projected to 2050 and 2080 (CMIP6),
sea level rise (IPCC AR6), coastal and river flood depth by scenario (WRI Aqueduct), water
stress now and projected, drought (SPI), aridity, burned area, land cover, elevation, land
subsidence and the Köppen climate zone. Every value names its source, year, unit, licence and
the size of the cell it is read from.
